QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Athena Pierce's Concerns
QuestInfo.0: Athena Pierce in the Altaire Camp Conference Room has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: Go visit #b#eShadrion#k#n, who's investigating the Southern Region of Mossy Tree Forest, and ask about the situation there.
QuestInfo.2: You met Shadrion at #m300020000# and asked about the situation there.

0.0: It rains too much in this forest. If the dragons hadn't attacked the Airship when they did...\r\n#L0##bYou look worried.#l\n#k
0.1: I'm wondering if we should start looking for another place to move to, such as a plain with better weather... Ephenia worries me, too.\r\n#L0##bWho's Ephenia?#l\n#k
0.2: Ephenia is the ruler of the fairies in this forest. She's...not that friendly to us, you know. Oh...I guess you don't know. Well, forget I said anything. Anyway, do you think you can do me a favor?

yes.0: As you know, the young people are searching for new land for us to move to. One of them, #b#eShadrion#k#n, should be in the #rSouthern Region of Mossy Tree Forest#k. Could you go find him and find out what the situation there is?

no.0: I guess this isn't a good time for you. Honestly, though, it isn't a good time for any of us.

1.0: Kao! Over here! What brought you all the way out here?

yes.0: Oh, Athena Pierce sent you... I see. Give me a moment.

npc.0: Go talk to #b#eShadrion#k#n in the #rSouthern Region of Mossy Tree Forest#k.
